description: Pushes Telemetry and EVRs to TimescaleDB to be viewed with Grafana

defaultTags.title: Default tags
defaultTags.description: Adds tags to all telemetry coming through. Useful when you want to attach session information to telemetry for indexing

password.title: Password
password.description: TimescaleDB password. Might not be needed for localhost.

database.title: Database Name
database.description: TimescaleDB database where this session's data will be pushed to. All telemetry from all FSW sources will be pushed here during this session.

ert.title: ERT
ert.description: Attach Earth-Return-Time as an additional field to every point
